needs_pass2_reason: The text layer is a poor OCR scan: 9 cells needed correction after the image check (dropped digits, 0/1 and 3/5 confusions, 'l'/'I' for 1, minus signs), so a blind second pass is required.
title: Heat capacity of aqueous CaCl2 from 306 to 603 K at 17.5 MPa
authors: Dorothy E. White, Anne L. Doberstein, Jeffrey A. Gates, David M. Tillett, Robert H. Wood
experimental_method: Differential flow heat-capacity calorimeter: electric power needed for equal temperature rise with sample solution and pure water flowing, calibrated with 3.0 mol/kg NaCl; apparent molar heat capacities of CaCl2(aq) at m 0.05 to 3.0 mol/kg, 306 to 603 K, 17.5 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: Per-point accuracy delta printed in the table (footnote b); fit standard error 16.9 J/K/mol over 216 points.
quality_remarks: Of the 221 points of the main run the authors eliminated 5 as not in reasonable agreement (marked e in the Delta column: 403.95 K, 451.18 K, 577.89 K x2, 602.68 K); the 11 rows at 2.12, 4.81 and 10.09 MPa near 306 K are also marked e (not used in the spline fit). All 232 printed rows are kept. Large replicate scatter at m=0.0507 and high T (e.g. -1156 to -1320 J/K/mol at 577.89 K). Temperature scale not stated.

not_extracted_tables.reason: knot positions and knot values of the cubic-spline surface, Debye-Hueckel slopes (fitted / model-generated)
